ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p174/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p174/r12.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p174/r12.claim: Noah's brotherhood may mean kinship or shared human kind; poetry uses brother of a tribe to mean one of its members.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p174/r12.anchor: وإخوة نوح قيل: في النسب. وقيل: في المجانسة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r1.claim: The object of fearing is unexpressed: it may be God's punishment for shirk, or disobedience to God by worshipping idols.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r1.anchor: ألا تتقون عذاب الله وعقابه على شرككم؟ وقيل: ألا تتقون مخالفة أمر الله

RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r5.claim: Noah is called their brother because he was one of them; Arab usage addresses a person as “brother of Banū Tamīm” to mean a member of that group.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r5.anchor: فلأنه كان منهم ، من قول العرب يا أخا بني تميم

RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r6.claim: Noah first warns his people because they accepted their religions through imitation; a person following blindly needs fear to prompt reflection and argument.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r6.anchor: القوم إنما قبلوا تلك الأديان للتقليد والمقلد إذا خوف خاف

RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.claim: The repeated call to fear God has distinct grounds: first, they should not disobey God’s messenger; again, they should not disobey a messenger who asks no wage. Rāzī compares this to repeating a rebuke for separate reasons.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.anchor: لأنه في الأول أراد ألا تتقون مخالفتي وأنا رسول الله

BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r4.claim: The temporal clause describes the extended period of denial and the events between both sides until the matter ended.
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r4.anchor: ظرف للتكذيب على أنه عبارة عن زمان مديد وقع فيه ما وقع من الجانبين إلى تمام الأمر.

BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r5.claim: Noah is called their brother by lineage so they would know his truthfulness and faithfulness, and recognize his language, making acceptance easier.
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r5.anchor: في النسب لئلا يجهل أمره في الصدق والديانة ولتعرف لغته فيؤدي ذلك إلى القبول.

BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r6.claim: “Noah” is an explanatory apposition clarifying “their brother.”
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r6.anchor: {نوح} عطف بيان لأخوهم. {ألا تتقون} الله حيث تعبدون غيره

BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r7.claim: Noah urges them to fear God because they worship others besides Him.
BURSEVI:v6p211#3/r7.anchor: الله حيث تعبدون غيره. وبالفارسية (أيا منمي ترسيد از خداي تعالى كه ترك عبادت أو ميكنيد)

STUDYQURAN:26:106/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:106/r1.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:26:106/r1.claim: Calling Noah their brother means that he belonged to their people.
STUDYQURAN:26:106/r1.anchor: Their brother means that he was one of them (R).

STUDYQURAN:26:106/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:106/r2.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:26:106/r2.claim: Taqwā here can mean being mindful or careful, specifically avoiding disobedience toward God.
STUDYQURAN:26:106/r2.anchor: Here being reverent is also interpreted as being mindful or careful, meaning, “Will you not be mindful of disobedience toward Me?” (R).

TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r1.claim: Noah’s people denied God’s messengers when their brother Noah called them to fear the punishment for disbelief and denying the messengers.
TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r1.anchor: الله {أمين} [الأعراف: 68] على وحيه إلي، برسالته إياي إليكم.

TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.claim: After the stories of Moses and Abraham, the account turns to Noah, the first of the foremost prophets; most of his people disbelieved, so God drowned them and saved Noah and the believers with him.
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.anchor: وهو أول أولي العزم سادة الأنبياء

TABATABAI:26:105-110/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r9.claim: “Their brother” means a kinsman, as in expressions such as a brother of Tamim or Kalb; the question is reproachful.
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r9.anchor: المراد بالأخ النسيب كقولهم أخو تميم واخو كليب والاستفهام للتوبيخ

TABRISI:26:105-111/r15.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:105-111/r15.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:105-111/r15.claim: Noah is their brother by lineage, not by religion.
TABRISI:26:105-111/r15.anchor: أي في النسب لا في الدين

TABRISI:26:105-111/r16.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:105-111/r16.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:105-111/r16.claim: Noah asks them to fear God's punishment for denying and opposing him.
TABRISI:26:105-111/r16.anchor: عذاب الله تعالى في تكذيبي ومخالفتي

THALABI:v7p172#2/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p172#2/r4.speaker: author
THALABI:v7p172#2/r4.claim: Noah is called their brother by lineage, not by religion.
THALABI:v7p172#2/r4.anchor: إذ قال لهم أخوهم في النسبة لا في الدين نوح ألا تتقون

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس وجميع المفسرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r1.claim: Noah was their brother by lineage, not religion; he was one of their own people.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: ابن أبيهم، يعني: أن الأخوة كانت من جهة النسب

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r2.speaker: الزجاج
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r2.claim: Every messenger comes speaking his people's language to make the proof clearer to them.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p82#2/r2.anchor: قال الزجاج: كل رسول يأتي بلسان قومه، ليوضح لهم الحجة،

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r1.claim: The continuation cites 14:4 to support that every messenger speaks his people's language so the proof is clearer.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r1.anchor: وما أرسلنا من رسول إلا بلسان قومه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r2.claim: The expression was explained earlier in this sura, asking why people do not avert God's punishment by obedience.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r1.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r1.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r1.claim: Noah is their brother by lineage, not by religion.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r1.anchor: {إذ قال لهم أخوهم نوح} [الشعراء: 106] أخوهم في النسب وليس بأخيهم في الدين.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r2.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r2.speaker: السدي
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r2.claim: Al-Suddī explains the appeal as “Will you not fear God?”; Noah commands them to fear Him.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r2.anchor: {ألا تتقون} [الشعراء: 106] يقول: ألا تخشون الله، وهو تفسير السدي، يأمرهم أن يتقوا الله.

ELMALILI:26:105-122/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r2.claim: Noah is called their brother because he belonged to the same people.
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r2.anchor: Kardeşleri Nûh yani aynı kavimden olan Nûh.

ELMALILI:26:105-122/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r3.claim: Noah asks his people whether they will not fear God.
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r3.anchor: O vakit ki kardeşleri Nûh onlara şöyle demişti: “Siz Allah’tan korkmaz mısınız?

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.claim: Noah’s call has the same essential principles as Moses’s and Abraham’s, and their peoples’ beliefs and responses to true religion were alike; the three narrative groups deliver the same message.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.anchor: Sonuç itibariyle her üç peygambere dair âyetler grubunda da aynı mesajlar verilmiştir

DAMGHANI:v1p493/r8.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p493/r8.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p493/r8.claim: اتقوا can mean fear; Noah's question means, do you not fear?
DAMGHANI:v1p493/r8.anchor: اتقوا يعني اخشوا قوله تعالى في سورة النساء يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم يعني اخشوا ربكم مثلها في سورة الحج

SAMIN-DURR:26:105/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:26:105/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:26:105/r2.claim: The object of tattaqūn is omitted and understood as God’s punishment.
SAMIN-DURR:26:105/r2.anchor: وحذف مفعول " تتقون " أي: ألا تتقون عقاب الله

ZAJJAJ:v4p95/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p95/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p95/r4.claim: Noah is called their brother because he belonged to their people.

ZAJJAJ:v4p95/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p95/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p95/r5.claim: Messengers speak the language of their people so the proof will be established and made clearer to them.
ZAJJAJ:v4p95/r5.anchor: وكل رسول يأتي بلسان قومه ليوضع لهم الحجة ويكون أبين لهم

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r3.claim: Noah's question asking whether they fear God carries a warning.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r3.anchor: The expression “Do you people not have fear?” carries an element of warning in it

ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r1.claim: إذ is a time adverb for their denial, understood over the extended period from the beginning of Noah's mission through its end.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r1.anchor: على أنه عبارة عن زمان مديد وقع فيه ما وقع من الجانبين إلى تمام الأمر

ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r2.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r2.claim: Some instead read إذ as causal: the people denied because Noah said the following words.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r2.anchor: وزعم بعضهم أن ( إذ ) للتعليل أي كذبت لأجل أن قال لهم

ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r3.claim: Brother here means a fellow tribesman or kinsman, as in the idiom 'brother of the Arabs' or 'brother of Tamim.'
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r3.anchor: نسيبهم كما يقال : يا أخا العرب ويا أخا تميم

ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r4.claim: The cited poetic line uses أخاهم for their kinsman, supporting the tribal rather than literal sense of brother.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r4.anchor: وعلى ذلك قوله : لايسألون أخاهم حين يندبهم في النائبات

ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r5.claim: The pronoun in لهم refers to Noah's people; the alternative that it refers to the messengers takes brotherhood as shared species and is contrary to the apparent sense.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r5.anchor: والضمير لقوم نوح وقيل : هو للمرسلين والأخوة المجانسة وهو خلاف الظاهر

ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r6.claim: Noah asks whether they fear God while worshiping someone other than Him.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p106#4/r6.anchor: الله عز وجل حيث تعبدون غيره

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r1.claim: Noah is called their brother by lineage, not by religion.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r1.anchor: إذ قال لهم أخوهم} في النسب لا في الدين.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r3.claim: Noah is called their brother because he belonged to their people.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r4.claim: He calls them to fear God by abandoning worship of other than Him.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r4.anchor: ألا تتقون } الله فتتركوا عبادة غيره.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r12.claim: Noah’s people did not pause to request evidence or seek a gracious approach before responding to his call.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r12.anchor: لم يتأنوا بطلب دليل , ولا ابتغاء وجه جميل

BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r13.claim: Calling Noah their brother recalls his kinship with them and consoles Muhammad; the expression also models good manners and gentleness in winning them over.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r13.anchor: زيادة في تسلية هذا النبي الكريم

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.speaker: عبيد بن عمير الليثي
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.claim: Ubayd ibn Umayr reports that people strangled Noah until he fainted; on recovering he prayed for their forgiveness, and after generations of worsening defiance he complained to God.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.anchor: عبيد بن عمير الليثي انه كان يحدث انه بلغه انهم كانوا يبسطونه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r2.claim: إذ is a temporal adverb: they denied Noah when he said ألا تتقون, and answered with their objection about his low-status followers.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r3.claim: Noah had likely called them repeatedly before this admonition, which came when he saw them persist in disbelief; their reply about the lowly followers supports this.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r3.anchor: صدر بعد أن دعاهم من قبل وكرر دعوتهم إذ رآهم مصرين على الكفر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r4.claim: The sūra selects this episode from Noah’s career because its parallel with Muhammad’s situation consoles the Prophet.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r4.anchor: هذا الموقف من مواقفه لأنه أنسب بغرض السورة في تسلية الرسول

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r5.claim: Here brother means a kinsman belonging to the same tribe.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p157/r5.anchor: والأخ مستعمل في معنى القريب من القبيلة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r1.claim: One analysis takes ألا as interrogative hamza plus negative لا; the question denies their piety and implies refusal to comply with Noah’s call.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r1.anchor: مركبا من حرفين همزة استفهام دخلت على ( لا ) النافية

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r2.claim: Alternatively, ألا is a single exhortative particle, implying that they are slow to believe Noah.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r2.anchor: حرفا واحدا هو حرف التحضيض مثل قوله تعالى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r3.claim: Piety here means fearing God’s punishment for associating partners with Him.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r3.anchor: خشية الله من عقابه إياهم على أن جعلوا معه شركاء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r3.claim: Noah is called their brother through shared lineage and origin, not shared religion.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r3.anchor: وقوله أخوهم يريد في النسب والمنشأ لا في الدين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r1.claim: Noah was their brother by lineage, not by religion.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r1.anchor: كانت الأخوة من جهة النسب بينهم لا من جهة الدين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r2.claim: He urges them to fear God's punishment by affirming His oneness and obeying Him.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#3/r2.anchor: ألا تتقون عذاب الله بتوحيده وطاعته

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r3.claim: Noah asks whether they fear God in worshiping others besides Him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r3.anchor: أي: ألا (2) تخافون الله في عبادتكم غيره؟

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r3.claim: Noah is called their brother because he belonged to their people; Arabs likewise call a member of a tribe its brother.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r3.anchor: قيل : أخوهم ؛ لأنه كان منهم ، من قول العرب : يا أخا بني تميم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r4.claim: The cited Ḥamāsa verse uses “their brother” for a fellow tribesman called on in adversity.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r4.anchor: ومنه بيت الحماسة : لا يسألون أخاهم حين يندبهم … في النائبات على ما قال برهانا

MUQATIL:26:105-111/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r2.claim: Noah was their brother by lineage, not by religion.
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r2.anchor: ليس بأخيهم فى الدين، ولكن أخوهم فى النسب

MUQATIL:26:105-111/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r3.claim: The call to be God-conscious means to fear God.
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r3.anchor: يعنى ألا تخشون الله عز وجل

NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#5/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#5/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#5/r1.claim: Noah is their brother by lineage, not by religion.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#5/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#5/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#5/r2.claim: He calls them to fear the Creator of all people and abandon idol worship.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r5.claim: “Their brother” means Noah was their kinsman, sharing their fatherhood, not their religion.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r5.anchor: أي ابن أبيهم وهي أخوة نسب لا أخوة دين

QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r6.claim: Another explanation is brotherhood of kind or shared human nature.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r7.claim: The expression is related to the principle that messengers speak in their own people’s language.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r7.anchor: قال الله تعالى: ومآ أرسلنا من رسول إلا بلسان قومه

QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r8.claim: The Arabic address “O brother of Banū Tamīm” can mean simply one of their number; al-Zamakhsharī cites a verse from the Ḥamāsa.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:105-106/r8.anchor: وقيل: هو من قول العرب يا أخا بني تميم. يريدون يا واحدا منهم. الزمخشري: ومنه بيت الحماسة:

QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r1.claim: Noah asks whether they will fear God regarding their worship of idols.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r1.anchor: { ألا تتقون } أي ألا تتقون الله في عبادة الأصنام.
